# Xenovoya

Launch the Xenovoya open alpha: a cooperative hex expedition about exploring, sharing discoveries, and escaping together.

## Core Pages

- [Play Xenovoya](https://play.xenovoya.com): Launch the Xenovoya open alpha: a cooperative hex expedition about exploring, sharing discoveries, and escaping together.
- [Xenovoya data and privacy](https://play.xenovoya.com/privacy): Understand local storage, optional cloud history, privacy-safe analytics, export, deletion, and shared game records.
